summary:
Brand, copy and sections review of mockup 15 (Beer Die Studio). All outputs are in C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\brand. Below, "brand\..." means a path inside that folder.

Comparisons were made against a local serve of the built site (dist/). That build is from Sep 14 and predates commit 7324487, so it still says "with no connection to the fraternity's former Tau Tau chapter… clean start". It was used only for visuals and styles, never as a copy reference.

What passes:
- The palette tokens navy, navy-dark, gold, gold-dark and cream are defined as on the live site.
- Headings and body use Cormorant Garamond, Cormorant SC and Source Sans 3.
- The Tau Tau rule holds. Line 323 says "Once it is rechartered, the colony will become the Tau Tau chapter again", and nothing describes the colony as unconnected.
- "Beer" appears only in <title> ("Beer Die Studio", the naming every mockup 01-14 uses), never in page copy. The chip reads "15 Studio" to match.
- The cups are empty and the scroll cue is fine.
- No console errors, and no horizontal overflow at 1440 or 390.

What fails: 6 major and 2 minor findings, below.
1. On phones the closing card covers the whole payoff.
2. Once the die lands, its cup renders milky white on phones and reads as a filled glass.
3. At scroll 0 the hero is streaked by the table's grain and full-width pinstripes, about 20x the live hero's pixel noise.
4. After the crane, 69% of the frame is desaturated slate rather than navy.
5. The solid nav is a grey bar (#626468) over every section.
6. The aims section is still mockup 14's card grid. JetBrains Mono is still loaded and visible in "AIM 01-03" and the chip.
7. Minor: small glow and off-palette leftovers in the nav and hero chrome.
8. Minor: the colony section, CTAs, closing-card eyebrow and footer have drifted from the live copy.

Every fix was applied to copies of the file and re-rendered. brand\exp\15-final2.html carries all of them. brand\patch_brandfix.py applies the CSS, markup and JS fixes to a fresh copy. brand\brand_shoot.py is the capture script, including the live-site comparison.

findings.title: On phones the closing card covers the thrower, the table and the die in the cup
findings.evidence: At 390x844 and t=5.0, #landed measures y 403-760: 357 px, or 42% of the screen, sitting right over the scene. Only the rims of the two far cups show above it. The thrower, the table and the landed die are behind it (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\brand\cap\mock-m-landed.png). At 375x667 the card spans y 226-583 and none of the scene is visible (left half of C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\brand\cap\se-compare.png). Meanwhile the top ~250 px of the phone frame is empty backdrop.

findings.title: On phones the cup holding the die turns milky white with a bright top and reads as a filled glass
findings.evidence:
From the phone camera (behind the thrower), the far-right cup is clear at t=1.88. Once the die lands it turns milky white with a white disc at the rim, at t=4.0 and t=5.0 (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\brand\cap\cup-before-after.png). The cup interior averages RGB (133,139,147). At about 35 px tall it reads as a full glass with a head, which is exactly what the empty-cups / no-alcohol-imagery rule guards against. Fixing brand-1 exposes it fully. On desktop the navy die shows clearly through the glass.

Five changes did not fix it; the cup stayed white with each: glass envMapIntensity 0.35, warm env card 0.6 to 0.15, FrontSide glass, die clearcoat 0 with env 0.4, and bumpScale 0.2 (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\brand\cap\cup-bump-notrans.png). Turning transmission off does fix it: the cup averages (95,101,112), and the die and its gold pips are visible inside a clearly empty glass.

findings.title: At scroll 0 the hero is streaked by the table texture, while the live hero is a clean navy field
findings.evidence:
The 900 grain strokes (alpha .05-.13) and the full-width gold rules are painted into the top's albedo map. Seen straight down, they show as vertical streaks across the whole hero.

Measured in an empty band (y 120-200, x 700-1100) as mean |luma difference| between pixels 4 px apart:
- Desktop: 1.43 (max 10.5) here, against 0.07 (max 1.6) on the live build, about 20x.
- Phone: 1.06, against 0.12 live.
See C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\brand\crop-hero-texture.png, plus a contrast-stretched copy in crop-hero-texture-x4.png. The live hero's rules sit only on the left 62% of the width, at about 0.04 alpha.

findings.title: After the crane, most of the frame is desaturated slate grey rather than brand navy
findings.evidence:
At t=5.0 on desktop the floor measures #2a3546 (HSL saturation 25%, lightness 22%) and the far floor #1c2433. 69% of the frame below the nav is low-saturation mid-dark. Only the table top (#062749) is on palette; navy #0b2545 has 72% saturation. The phone floor measures #3d4555 (16% saturation).

The cause: the satin floor (0x0d1b30, roughness 0.62, default envMapIntensity 1) reflects the white softboxes as a grey sheen. See C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\brand\base-d-06.png.
findings.fix:
Floor material: new T.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0b2545, roughness: 0.85, metalness: 0, envMapIntensity: 0.25 }).

Verified:
- Floor #2a3546 becomes #192e4a (49% saturation).
- Far floor becomes #07162c, close to navy-dark.
- The slate share of the frame drops from 69% to 5%.
- Phone floor becomes #1d2e48.
- Table, shadows and figure are unchanged.
See C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\brand\cap\floorA-d-t5.png and floorA-m-t5.png.

Optional and untested: change scene.background and the fog from 0x07111f to 0x071931, the navy-dark token.

findings.title: The solid nav turns into a neutral grey bar over every section after the stage
findings.evidence: The solid nav is rgba(3,10,22,.62), mockup 14's near-black --void colour. Over the cream and white sections it composites to grey: (98,100,104), #626468, on desktop and (99,103,111) on phone (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\brand\base-d-s1.png and base-m-s1.png). The live nav is rgba(11,37,69,.82) and measures navy (54,75,100) over the same cream (cap\live-d-navover.png). The phone menu panel is rgba(3,10,22,.96), near-black, where the live one is navy-dark.

findings.title: The aims section is still mockup 14's card grid, and JetBrains Mono is still loaded and visible
findings.evidence:
The 15 block's own comment (line 176) says the sections go back to the live site's editorial look. Instead, the aims are three boxed white cards labelled 'AIM 01/02/03' in JetBrains Mono. The computed font of .card__n is JetBrains Mono, and both its weights (400 and 600) are requested and loaded. The fixed '15 Studio' chip is also set in mono.

The live page uses a pinned heading column (eyebrow, h2, and the 'In Hoc Signo Vinces' note in Cormorant SC) beside hairline index rows with 01/02/03 ordinals in Cormorant SC gold-dark. Its CSS calls that layout 'the editorial replacement for a grid of cards'. Compare C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\brand\cap\mock-d-sec0.png with cap\live-d-sec0.png.

The stats band also drifts: it left-aligns sentence-case labels, where the live strip centres uppercase labels tracked at .06em.

findings.title: Glow and off-palette leftovers in the scroll-0 chrome, an undefined --ink, and the chip covering copy on phones
findings.evidence:
Computed at scroll 0, against the live site:
- The active nav link is rgb(240,207,98), --gold-hi #f0cf62, which is not a palette token. Live uses rgb(201,162,39) with a 2px gold underline.
- The nav crest carries a gold glow, drop-shadow(rgba(201,162,39,.45) 0 0 6px). Live has none.
- The focus ring uses --gold-hi.
- The hero standfirst is cream at .72 opacity (live .86).
- The hero rule is 2px (live 3px).
- Eyebrow tracking is .24em (live .22em). On a phone that wraps the hero eyebrow as '…IN ST. / LOUIS · BETA COLONY' (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\brand\base-m-00.png).

.sect--aims and .sect--join set color: var(--ink), but --ink is never defined, so both compute to cream rgb(250,247,240) on a cream or white ground. This is latent: every visible element currently sets its own colour.

On phones the fixed '15 Studio' chip sits over section copy: it covers 'Justice' and 'Something New' in base-m-s0.png and base-m-s1.png.

findings.title: The colony section, its CTAs, the closing-card eyebrow and the footer have drifted from the live copy
findings.evidence:
(a) The colony copy is a single Source Sans paragraph with straight quotes. The live page sets the first two sentences as a navy Cormorant Garamond lede, and the coordinator's quote as grey body text in curly quotes (C:\Users\wccoy\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Projects-sigma-chi-website\6bf3cb6c-9ead-4650-a69f-a89411f0a84f\scratchpad\shots\wf15\brand\cap\mock-d-sec2.png). The Tau Tau sentence itself is correct.
(b) Both CTAs are href="#top". Clicking 'Join Our Founding Class' at the bottom of the page jumps to scrollY 0, which sets dir = -1 and rewinds the toss back to the hero. The live section has only 'Meet the Colony'.
(c) The status badge has lost the live site's WashU-green 'good standing' treatment.
(d) The closing card's eyebrow, 'Spring 2026 founding class', names a semester that has already passed (the page's own copy says that class began forming in spring 2026), and it sits above a Join button.
(e) The footer keeps only the disclaimer. It drops two notes from the live footer: the trademark note ('The shield mark used on this site was drawn for the colony and is not a reproduction of the official Sigma Chi coat of arms', which the README cites for the crest on the die) and the non-discrimination and 'Hazing is prohibited' note. That matters on the one page built around a drinking game, which the README says needs the risk manager's sign-off. Compare cap\mock-d-sec3.png with cap\live-d-sec3.png.
